integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the printed payoff averages, replicator definitions, simplification statement, and baseline parameters. The decisive counterexample is exact algebra and does not rely on simulation or on ambiguous OCR of the Brownian term.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the boundary dynamics and state-space invariance of the simplified replicator drift. It does not reconstruct every risk-adjusted stochastic equation and does not claim that all interior equilibrium locations change.
title: Dropping complement factors destroys the probability cube in a tripartite replicator model
